scene nightsky
It was a normal night at a local bar.
lines.zh: 这是当地一家酒吧里再平常不过的夜晚。

lines.en: Unfortunately, the word “normal” had taken on a new meaning for its proprietor recently.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，对它的老板娘来说，“平常”这个词最近有了新的含义。

lines.en: Or perhaps it would be more accurate to say it had taken on an {i}older{/i} one.
lines.zh: 或者，说它回到了一个{i}更旧{/i}的含义，也许更准确。

lines.en: One where the baseline was lowered from somewhere near happy to somewhere closer to the dirt.
lines.zh: 那时的基准线，从勉强算得上快乐的地方，一路降到了更贴近泥土的深处。

lines.en: This had good and bad sides, you see.
lines.zh: 这事有好有坏，你瞧。

lines.en: The good was that the slightest thing now could turn an average day into a great one.
lines.zh: 好的是，如今再微小的一件事，都能把平淡的一天变成极好的一天。

lines.en: The bad was that, despite how much easier it would be to improve at this point, things seldom seemed to click.
lines.zh: 坏的是，尽管到了这一步想要变好已经容易得多，事情却很少真的对上拍子。

lines.en: And that statement applied to more than just one person as you’ll see shortly.
lines.zh: 而这番话适用于的不止一个人——你很快就会看到。

lines.en: scene sarasadayanebar1
: Should we, like...say something?

lines.en: : You don’t think the bar might be going out of business, do you?

lines.en: : Th...then...would I be able to get another-
lines.zh: : 那……那我能再来一……

lines.en: : Just take whatever you want. It’s on the house tonight.
lines.zh: : 想拿什么就拿吧。今晚我请客。

lines.en: : I somehow feel even weirder now.
lines.zh: : 我现在反而觉得更不自在了。

: Thanks for coming to Sakaki-bar-a. The last family-run bar in Kumon-mi. Probably.

lines.en: A normal night it was — just one that leaned closer to the negatives than the aforementioned hope for a possible uptick in whatever chemical could contort one’s face into a smile.
lines.zh: 这是一个平常的夜晚——只是比起前面提到过的那点可能上扬的希望，它更偏向消极的一端。那种能把人的脸拧出一个笑容的化学物质，今晚也没起作用。

lines.en: For Sara, wine typically helped with that.
lines.zh: 对 Sara 来说，葡萄酒本来一直能帮上忙。

: It’s definitely a...weird predicament, yeah..
lines.zh: : 这确实是个……很古怪的处境，嗯……

lines.en: : And you know...I think Sensei might actually just {i}want{/i} to be a teenager sometimes. I don’t think he ever really {i}got{/i} to be one in the first place.
lines.zh: : 而且你知道……我觉得 Sensei 有时候可能真的只{i}想{/i}当个少年。我觉得他从来就没真正{i}当过{/i}一次。

lines.en: : I do too. Having a threesome with my daughter would be much less awkward if I was in the same grade as her.
lines.zh: : 我也这么想。要是我和她同年级，跟女儿玩三人行就没那么尴尬了。

lines.en: : You’re not...seriously considering actually doing that with her, though...right?
lines.zh: : 你该不会……真的在认真考虑跟她做那种事吧？……对吧？

lines.en: : What would you think of me if I {i}did,{/i} Ayane?
lines.zh: : 如果我{i}真做了{/i}，你会怎么看我，Ayane？

lines.en: scene sarasadayanebar22
: Am I somehow {i}above{/i} doing something like that in your head? Because if so, thank you. You already think more of me than Sana does.
lines.zh: : 在你心里，我就{i}高尚{/i}到做不出那种事吗？如果是，那谢谢你。你对我的评价已经比 Sana 高了。

lines.en: : Let’s face it, though — I’m not cut out to be a mother. I lost one child already. Now, the second one is begging to be taken away and framing {i}this{/i} as the one way to keep her close.
lines.zh: : 但面对现实吧——我不是当母亲的料。我已经失去过一个孩子了。现在第二个又在求着被人带走，还把{i}这{/i}说成是能让她留在身边的唯一办法。

lines.en: : At least if Sana and I are {i}both{/i} there with him, all three of us could “deepen our bond.” The same way you do when the two of you are alone.
lines.zh: : 至少如果我和 Sana {i}都{/i}陪在他身边，我们三个就能一起“加深羁绊”。就像你们两个独处时做的那样。

lines.en: : You don’t...mean that.
lines.zh: : 你不是……真心的。

lines.en: : You don’t {i}know{/i} that.
lines.zh: : 你又不{i}知道{/i}。

lines.en: : We Sakakibaras are cursed, you know. In more ways than one.
lines.zh: : 我们 Sakakibara 家的人是被诅咒的，你知道的。不止一种意义上的诅咒。

lines.en: : We’re not {i}allowed{/i} to be happy. Or live normal lives. But I tricked myself into thinking I could change that by building a home for my kids.
lines.zh: : 我们不被{i}允许{/i}幸福。也不被允许过正常的生活。可我骗自己说，只要给孩子们建一个家，就能改变这一点。

lines.en: : I never knew what I was doing, though. I {i}still{/i} don’t. I’m just fucking...not good at this. Any of it.
lines.zh: : 可我从来不知道自己在做什么。现在{i}也{/i}不知道。我只是他妈的……不擅长这些。任何一件都不擅长。

lines.en: : But at least you stayed...
lines.zh: : 但至少你留下来了……

lines.en: scene sarasadayanebar23
: At least you stayed, Sara...
lines.zh: : 至少你留下来了，Sara……

lines.en: : Even when you had to raise your kids on your own, you {i}stayed.{/i} And what I’ve learned through my experiences and tons of my friends, that seems to be the hardest part.
lines.zh: : 就算你必须独自把孩子拉扯大，你也{i}留下来{/i}了。而我从自己的经历和一大堆朋友身上学到的是，这似乎是最难的部分。

lines.en: : When I love something...I can’t bring myself to let go of it. It needs to be torn from me.
lines.zh: : 我一旦爱上什么……就没办法主动放手。它只能被人从我身上撕走。

lines.en: : I’m the same way. {i}That’s{/i} why I stay with Sensei. {i}That’s{/i} why I still cling to the idea that one day, I {i}will{/i} be enough.
lines.zh: : 我也是。{i}所以{/i}我才留在 Sensei 身边。{i}所以{/i}我才一直抓着那个念头不放——总有一天，我{i}会{/i}足够好的。

lines.en: : Just, in my head, that’s less of an idea and more of an eventuality. I {i}will{/i} be with him in the end. And if he ever leaves, I know at least one girl very experienced in finding him.
lines.zh: : 只不过在我脑子里，那不是念头，而是必然。最终我{i}一定{/i}会和他在一起。而如果他哪天离开了，我知道至少有一个姑娘非常擅长把他找回来。

lines.en: : You really are special, Ayane...
lines.zh: : 你真的很特别，Ayane……

lines.en: : You’re more confident in high school than I’ve {i}ever{/i} been at any point in my life.
lines.zh: : 你在高中时的这份自信，是我这辈子{i}任何时候{/i}都没有过的。

lines.en: : Just wait until I tell you how many kids {i}I’m{/i} going to have.
lines.zh: : 那你等我说{i}我{/i}要生几个孩子吧。

lines.en: scene sarasadayanebar24
: How many?
lines.zh: : 几个？

lines.en: : However many are on a football team?
lines.zh: : 一支橄榄球队是多少人来着？

lines.en: : Isn’t that like...forty? How are you going to afford that?
lines.zh: : 那不是得……四十个左右吗？你养得起吗？

lines.en: : I’m rich, remember?
lines.zh: : 我很有钱啊，记得吗？

lines.en: : Then how is your {i}body{/i} going to afford that? You’d need to start having a kid a year like...now.
lines.zh: : 那你的{i}身体{/i}养得起吗？你得从……现在开始，一年生一个。

lines.en: : Or just twenty sets of twins.
lines.zh: : 或者干脆二十对双胞胎。

lines.en: : Do twins run in your family? I’ve heard that’s a genetic thing.
lines.zh: : 你们家有双胞胎基因吗？我听说那是遗传的。

lines.en: : Not yet they don’t. A couple years from now, though? Who knows?
lines.zh: : 目前还没有。不过再过几年？谁知道呢。

lines.en: scene sarasadayanebar25
: Heh...
: {i}Now{/i} do you feel better?
lines.zh: : {i}现在{/i}你感觉好点了吗？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Fuck.
scene sarasadayanebar26
: I’m glad you came and talked to me, though. I’ve been in a pretty dark place ever since I watched my boyfriend impale my daughter.
lines.zh: : 不过我很高兴你来找我聊。自从看着我男朋友把我女儿钉穿之后，我一直处在挺阴暗的地方。

lines.en: : Ahh, see that’s where you’re wrong. Sensei is {i}my{/i} boyfriend. I’m just sharing him with all of you because I’m kind and like to give back to the community.
lines.zh: : 啊，你看，这点你错了。Sensei 是{i}我的{/i}男朋友。我只是把他分给你们的份让出来罢了，因为我人好，喜欢回馈社会。

lines.en: : There’s that confidence again. Can I borrow some of it so I can have the courage to ask my daughter why she now thinks incest is okay?
lines.zh: : 又是那种自信。能借我一点吗？好让我有勇气去问我女儿，为什么她现在觉得乱伦也没问题。

lines.en: : I can assure you that incest is perhaps the single most {i}tame{/i} thing on Sana’s kink list.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，乱伦大概是 Sana 的癖好清单上最{i}温和{/i}的一项了。

lines.en: : I’m both curious and terrified of what that could mean. I’m sure yours is no better though if you’ve been seeing Sensei for as long as you imply.
lines.zh: : 我既好奇又害怕那意味着什么。不过既然你暗示自己跟 Sensei 在一起这么久了，你的清单估计也好不到哪儿去。

lines.en: scene sarasadayanebar27
: Yeah...does that not weird you out?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那你不觉得别扭吗？

lines.en: : I’m more weirded out by my daughter wanting to have a threesome with me than my daughter’s friend wanting consensual sex with the guy she likes.
lines.zh: : 比起女儿想跟我玩三人行，女儿的朋友和自己喜欢的男生自愿上床，后者可没那么让我别扭。

lines.en: : No, not me. Sensei. I figured you’d be...less okay with, you know, him sleeping with more or less an entire school.
lines.zh: : 不，我不是说我。我是说 Sensei。我以为你会……更没法接受，你知道的，他跟几乎一整个学校的人上床。

lines.en: : I mean...I wouldn’t say I’m {i}okay{/i} with it. It’s certainly...unethical. But sleeping with my teacher was the single best choice I ever made because it gave me my children.
lines.zh: : 我……我不会说我能{i}接受{/i}。这当然……不道德。但和我的老师上床，是我这辈子做过的最棒的一个选择，因为它给了我孩子们。

lines.en: : It’d be wrong for me to take that from anyone else.
lines.zh: : 那我更没有立场把这从别人身上夺走。

lines.en: : With all due respect, that is a very irresponsible thing for an adult to say.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，一个成年人说这种话太不负责任了。

lines.en: : With all due respect, you’re okay with it too and you’re way smarter than I am even {i}with{/i} the age gap.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，你心里也一样接受，而且{i}就算{/i}隔着年龄差，你也比我聪明得多。

lines.en: : Fair enough. But I still-
lines.zh: : 说得也是。不过我还是——

lines.en: : We’re done talking about me, Ayane. You’ve said your piece and adequately filled in for my real daughter. Now it’s my turn to listen to you.
lines.zh: : 我的事就聊到这儿，Ayane。你的话都说完了，也充分代替我亲生女儿尽了责。现在轮到我听你说了。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I’m the closest thing to a mom that you have now, yeah? You must have a lot you want to get off your chest. And even if I look like this, I can still hear you out.
lines.zh: : 我现在是你最亲近的、相当于母亲的人，对吧？你心里一定憋着很多想说的话。就算我现在这副样子，也还是能听你说。

lines.en: : I mostly just wanted to come over here and tell you not to blame yourself but, if it’s okay, could I maybe yell a few things really loudly while you keep stroking my cheek?
lines.zh: : 我主要就是想过来告诉你别怪自己，不过，如果可以的话，我能不能在你继续摸着我脸的时候，大声吼几句话？

lines.en: : Sure. That works for me.
lines.zh: : 当然。我没问题。

lines.en: : Great. Here I go.
lines.zh: : 太好了。我开始了。

lines.en: scene sarasadayanebar28
: I CAN NOT BEGIN TO FATHOM NOR EXPLAIN THE HATE THAT I HAVE FOR THE FACT THAT MY STUPID PREDATOR BOYFRIEND-DAD KEEPS FUCKING ALL MY FRIENDS {b}AND{/b} THEIR MOMS!
lines.zh: : 我他妈根本无法理解也无法解释，我有多恨这件事——我那个愚蠢的、捕食者一样的男朋友爸爸，一直在操我所有的朋友{b}和{/b}她们的母亲！

lines.en: : I ALSO TAKE GREAT EXCEPTION TO THE FACT THAT THE ONES HE SEEMS TO PRIORITIZE ARE LESS LOVING AND LESS MATERNAL AND HAVE SMALLER BOOBS THAN ME!
lines.zh: : 我还极其不满的是，他似乎更偏爱的那些人，一个个都没我可爱、没我有母性，胸还比我小！

lines.en: : AS THE MORE PHYSICALLY AND EMOTIONALLY DEVELOPED LOVE INTEREST, IT SEEMS ONLY FAIR THAT I, AYANE AMAMIYA, WOULD BE THE FAVORITE! BUT NOPE! FUCK ME, I GUESS!
lines.zh: : 作为身心都发育得更成熟的女主角，按理说，我 Ayane Amamiya 才该是最受宠的那个！但并没有！操，随他便吧！

lines.en: : AND ALSO! ALL OF THIS MOM STUFF IS MAKING ME REALLY PISSED OFF AT MINE FOR LEAVING AND I COULD REALLY USE HER RIGHT NOW! NO OFFENSE TO SARA, THOUGH!
lines.zh: : 还有！所有这些关于妈妈的事，让我对我自己的妈妈火大得要命——她居然就这么走了，而我这会儿真的很需要她！不过 Sara 我无意冒犯！

lines.en: : OH! AND AMI?! REALLY FUCKING WEIRD ALL OF A SUDDEN! MAYA? HUGE BITCH! WHICH IS BASICALLY THE SAME AS SHE’S ALWAYS BEEN, BUT STILL! MASSIVE BITCH!
lines.zh: : 哦！还有 Ami？！突然之间他妈的怪得要死！Maya？天大的婊子！虽然基本跟她平时一个德性，但还是要说！超级大婊子！

lines.en: : MAKOTO SHOULD TRY HARDER! YUMI SHOULD CARE MORE! APOCALYPSES ARE CONFUSING AND SCI-FI STUFF ISN’T EVEN REALLY THAT INTERESTING! LIFE SUCKS! I’M HORNY!
lines.zh: : Makoto 该更努力一点！Yumi 该更上心一点！末日什么的太让人搞不懂了，科幻那套甚至压根没那么有意思！人生糟透了！我发情了！

lines.en: : OH AND ONE LAST THING! THE CONVENIENCE STORE CLOSEST TO THE DORMS STOPPED STOCKING THE CANNED COFFEE I LIKE AND NOW I HAVE TO BLOW IT UP! FUCK ME AGAIN!
lines.zh: : 哦，还有最后一件事！离宿舍最近的那家便利店不进我喜欢喝的罐装咖啡了，现在我得去把它炸掉！操，我真是服了！

lines.en: scene sarasadayanebar29
: Okay. I’m good now. Thank you, Sara.
lines.zh: : 好了。我现在没事了。谢谢你，Sara。

lines.en: : Don’t mention it. And if you ever need to talk-
lines.zh: : 不客气。还有，如果你什么时候需要聊聊——

lines.en: scene sarasadayanebar30
: I know where to find you.
lines.zh: : 我知道去哪儿找你。

lines.en: : What are you going to do about Sana though? She’s supposed to work on Saturday, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 不过你打算拿 Sana 怎么办？她周六不是该上班吗？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about me. You’ve done enough of that already.
lines.zh: : 别为我操心。你已经操心得够多了。

lines.en: : All I do is worry now. It’s really no big deal.
lines.zh: : 我现在只会操心。真的没什么大不了的。

lines.en: : Well, go worry at home. I’m gonna clean up in here and go to sleep.
lines.zh: : 那就回家去操心吧。我要在这儿收拾收拾，然后睡觉。

lines.en: : Want some help? I can check if Efrosinia is free right now. I heard she’s in town and I’m sure she wouldn’t mind.
lines.zh: : 要帮忙吗？我可以去问问 Efrosinia 现在有没有空。我听说她在城里，我相信她不会介意的。

lines.en: : I’d actually like some alone time if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 其实我想一个人待会儿，可以吗？

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : In the meantime, I’ll try and find a muzzle that fits your daughter so you don’t ever have to hear her say such gross things to you again.
lines.zh: : 与此同时，我会去找一个能套住你女儿的口塞，这样你就再也不用听她对你说那么恶心的话了。

lines.en: scene sarasadayanebar31
: Or...at least that’s what I {i}would{/i} do if I...wasn’t absolutely certain that she’d like it.
lines.zh: : 或者……至少如果我没有……百分之百确定她会喜欢的话，我{i}是会{/i}这么做的。

lines.en: : Ayane? Alone time?
lines.zh: : Ayane？一个人待会儿？

lines.en: scene black
: Right. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 对。抱歉。

lines.en: : And remember! Secret conversation! Because I have cried enough lately and can assure you that Sensei getting mad at me would only make me cry more!
lines.zh: : 还有记住！这是秘密谈话！因为我最近已经哭得够多了，我可以向你保证，Sensei 要是生我的气，只会让我哭得更厉害！

lines.en: : Of course, Ayane...
lines.zh: : 当然，Ayane……

lines.en: : I won’t tell anyone you were even here...
lines.zh: : 我不会告诉任何人你来过这儿……
